gifts.note: Trade him the Meteorite. Prof. Cozmo is only home after you defeat Team Magma at the top of Mt. Chimney. Take the Meteorite from the machine at the summit, bring it to his house in Fallarbor Town and say Yes when he asks for it. He gives you the Return TM in exchange.

Depends on friendship, once a week. This man in Pacifidlog Town judges the first Pokémon in your party.
Return: it must be very friendly toward you.
Frustration: it must be very unfriendly toward you.
In between he gives nothing. After giving a TM he makes you wait a week before the next.

Beat your Dad (Badge 5). The Petalburg Gym Leader battles you once you have the first four badges. After the battle you get TM Package 5 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case) and an Assault Vest. If your Bag had no room for the Assault Vest, talk to him again.
